findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false. Long-lived, never-rotated key material increases the blast radius if the key is ever compromised and conflicts with common compliance baselines for audit log encryption keys.

No policy argument is supplied, so AWS applies the default key policy granting the entire account root full kms:* access, meaning any IAM principal in the account with permissive IAM policies can use or administer the key protecting audit data. An explicit least-privilege key policy should restrict decrypt/administer rights to specific roles.
